scope: All five ordinary body-flow citation keys and all twelve frozen claim/citation pairs were checked for existence, canonical metadata, exact nearby support, hypotheses, numerical specialization, relevance, bibliography coverage, natural non-library coverage, and converged LaTeX/BibTeX consistency; no priority beyond the dated bounded search is certified.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check-skill search audit followed by a BibTeX consistency audit: claims were extracted and frozen first, then verified sequentially against primary article passages, authoritative publisher/archive records, the active user-library registry, and the final AUX/log join; no sub-agents were used because the user prohibited them.
